{ "rules": [
    "When sentiment is positive (≥0.67), forecast prices must be above both the latest close and model baseline to avoid undershooting",
    "When sentiment turns negative (≤-0.33), immediately pull forecasts toward mean reversion, cutting 3-5 points from baseline for near-term horizons",
    "Detect and correct forecast overshoot by 2-3 points when 30-day forecast exceeds latest close by more than 15%",
    "Apply horizontal bias correction: compress forecast range by 15% to eliminate excessive volatility compared to true outcomes",
    "When price has been rising rapidly (18-day slope > 0.5), dampen forecast growth by 20% to account for expected mean reversion",
    "Align forecast direction with sentiment reversal: when sentiment flips from positive to negative, reverse forecast trend within 24 hours",
    "Adjust mid-term forecasts (11-20 days) first, keeping 1-10 day forecasts closest to true outcomes while applying maximum correction" ]}
